testedSourceDigest.method: Sorted relative paths and bytes of files under src and src-tauri/src plus Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/tauri.conf.json/package.json/package-lock.json; path NUL bytes NUL for each file.

macos-final-scan100k.method: sum ps resident memory and reported CPU for all processes with matching resource and jetsam coalition IDs; RSS includes shared mappings and excludes compressed pages; ps CPU is smoothed, not instantaneous

macos-final-postscan-idle.method: sum ps resident memory and reported CPU for all processes with matching resource and jetsam coalition IDs; RSS includes shared mappings and excludes compressed pages; ps CPU is smoothed, not instantaneous

completed100kScan.counterMethod: Difference between snapshots before and after completed scan; JSON progress and page replies only, excludes command arguments, other replies, completion event and transport framing.

sourceContext: Measured pre-commit local source identified by testedSourceDigest; not final-delivery-source performance verification.
